title: Track Guide Oulton Park Fosters FF1600 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake close to left banner, 75% pressure, trail brake
corners.line: cut curb, use grass before car bounces
corners.exit: throttle close to curb, ease in

corners.label: T3
corners.exit: throw car over curbing, avoid going too far

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: brake at left white line, 90% pressure
corners.line: ease off brake to inside curb, take lower part
corners.mistakes: brake twice if miss first time

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: break once I get to this kink in the road here, 65% brake pressure
corners.line: ease off brake to first curb, stay close to second curb
corners.mistakes: overtaking attempts, going on throttle too early

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: break just before third part of road, 90% brake pressure
corners.line: aim for emergency road on right
corners.mistakes: going off into grass, going on throttle too early

general_tips: stay close to the left side of the track for turn 9
use the outside curb to maximize exit speed
